title: Notification regarding to constitute the regular sitting of the Division Benches and Single Benches as per the following table.

Imphal, the 20th June, 2025

litigants that Hon’ble The Chief Justice is pleased to constitute the regular sitting of the Division

• There shall be a Special Division Bench every Friday as per requirement.
This issue in supersession of all earlier notifications in this regard.
By Order etc.
